# Varman Metals

Industrial supplier in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Single current product
Remelted zinc ingots with 90–95% Zn, intended for brass manufacturing and compatible industrial alloying operations. Suitability and impurity limits are buyer-specific. Do not assume the material meets refined-zinc specifications.

## Quality reports
For purchase orders strictly greater than 10 metric tonnes, a quality analysis report is provided with each batch.

## Prices and inventory
The company quotes prices based on current availability, quantity, grade acceptance and destination. No fixed rate, dispatch time or stock quantity is promised on the website.
